## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Lotte Zweig an Therese Altmann [6. August 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.154
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.154
- Datum: 6.8.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
New York, Aug. 6th, 41

Dear mother
I have again received two letters
from you almost at the same time - one dated
June 7th and the other July 25th! Your birthday
letter to Eva I send to Mrs. Sch. to keep it
until that date - also Mamma's birthday letter
has already arrived and Mrs. Sch. is keeping
it back.
We have returned to NY yesterday.
We are not yet decided what we shall do and
whether we shall really return to South Am.
But for all these difficult considerations
and deliberations it is better to be in NY
in spite of the heat, Ossining was not far,
but travelling in and out almost every
day is more strenuous than being here. It
is not so bad in NY just now. We have
rooms with cross-ventilation, and if there is
any air at all, we get it. - It was a pity
to leave Oss. just when we had got used to it.
It was pleasant and I was glad to be near
Eva, and we had nice friends in the neighbourhood.
Well, it can't be helped and before you write me
again, inquire first at Manfred's where we are. We
shall cable them as soon as we know ourselves what
we are going to do.
I hope you enjoyed Jan's visit and keep well
yourself. Kindest regards and best love
Lotte.
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief in blauer Tinte. Sehr gut lesbar.
Rückseite des Dokuments, leer (durchscheinender Text der Vorderseite sichtbar).
